enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner set to low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Adjust air conditioner remote. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Cup hands under water. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast while listening to the news on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Pick up phone. Open news app. Place phone on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take plate. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Pour boiling water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Sip tea. Listen to news.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing the work bag and phone for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Remove casual clothes. Put on work shirt. Put on trousers. Button shirt. Zip trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up work bag. Open bag. Place phone in bag. Place charger in bag. Zip bag. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Buckle seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Press accelerator. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the day shift as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take out scrubs. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient charts. Review notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Walk to next patient. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital ahead of the evening storm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Buckle seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Press accelerator. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unbuckle seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating while checking the storm weather updates on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Place on counter. Take out cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open weather app. Check updates. Pick up fork. Eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up after the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub. Rinse. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Storm preparation: charging the phone and computer, closing windows and keeping the space heater unplugged
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up phone. Plug phone charger into wall. Connect phone. Pick up computer. Plug computer charger. Connect computer. Walk to window. Close window. Lock window. Walk to another window. Close. Lock. Walk to space heater. Check plug. Unplug space heater.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the lights dimmed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Press channel button. Adjust volume. Walk to light switch. Turn dial to dim lights. Walk back to sofa. Sit down. Pick up phone. Scroll. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Scroll. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, reading on the phone under the desk lamp with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Scroll. Read. Adjust pillow. Lie down. Read. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off fan. Place phone on nightstand. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the air conditioner set to a comfortable night temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Adjust air conditioner remote. Sleep.
